# BDK Supply
> Building and renovation supplies for bathrooms, doors & hardware, and kitchen & laundry.

## API
- OpenAPI: https://david-ecomm.vercel.app/api/v1/openapi.json
- Products: https://david-ecomm.vercel.app/api/v1/products
- Product feed: https://david-ecomm.vercel.app/api/feeds/products.json
- Categories: https://david-ecomm.vercel.app/api/v1/categories
- Search: https://david-ecomm.vercel.app/api/v1/search?q=vanity

## Notes
- Prices are represented in Australian cents.
- Phase 1 storefront supports mock catalog data when Supabase environment variables are not configured.
